mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes volume depletion and hypotension, which is additive with sildenafil's vasodilatory effects, increasing hypotension risk; sildenafil is metabolized by CYP3A4 which may be affected by electrolyte disturbances from thiazide therapy.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; ensure adequate hydration and assess electrolytes; dose adjustment of sildenafil may be needed in patients on chlorthalidone; caution in those with cardiovascular disease.
